entry_filter.name: spy_weekly_drop_1pct
entry_filter.description: SPY rolling 5-session close return crosses from above -1% to <= -1%; no correlation gate; entry next observed common session

ratio.description: fixed QQQ LONG PUT 1 : SPY SHORT PUT 6; entry and exit require displayed side size for every contract

mark_path.note: Single-cohort floating marks only; not portfolio NAV drawdown.

model.virtual_path: max(actual SPY close, 90% of each trade's entry SPY close)
model.repricing: Observed SPY put ask plus Black-Scholes price change from actual to virtual spot at same-day IV; observed quote residual is preserved.
model.qqq_leg: Historical QQQ long-put bid marks unchanged
model.missing_iv: Use implied-volatility inversion from actual ask where possible; fallback sigma 0.80 if quote IV and inversion are unavailable.

limitations: Modelled virtual quote, not an actual tradable quote; Black-Scholes approximation for American-style SPY puts.
Uses zero rates and zero dividend yield; same-day IV may be stale/noisy and quote residual is preserved.
Only common-session closes are used; intraday floor breaches are missed.
Overlapping episode P&L sums do not equal account returns or CAGR.
Peak assignment notional is a contract-notional proxy, not broker margin; no portfolio cash, margin, assignment funding, forced liquidation, financing or compounding.
The model changes SPY option marks but does not model counterfactual liquidity or altered discretionary decisions.
